name: flm-vscode
description: Interact with and manage a FastFlowLM server from VS Code

apiKey.description: Optional API key for the FastFlowLM server.

chatParticipants.name: flm
chatParticipants.description: Interact directly with a FastFlowLM server.

commands.name: models
commands.description: List models available from the server.

commands.name: update
commands.description: Check for and install a newer FLM release.

commands.name: collaborate
commands.description: Coordinate the selected model with explicitly mentioned language models.

chatParticipants.name: hermes
chatParticipants.description: Use the configured Hermes harness via the chat.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Check whether the configured Hermes harness is available.

flm-vscode.serverUrl.description: Base URL for the FastFlowLM OpenAI-compatible API.

flm-vscode.model.description: Model identifier sent to the FastFlowLM server.

flm-vscode.apiKey.markdownDescription: Optional API key for the FastFlowLM server.

flm-vscode.serverCommand.description: Optional command used to start the local FastFlowLM server.

flm-vscode.serverArgs.description: Arguments passed to the configured FastFlowLM server command.

flm-vscode.serverCwd.description: Working directory for the configured FastFlowLM server command. Defaults to the first workspace folder.

flm-vscode.checkForUpdates.description: Check for the FLM executable and newer FastFlowLM releases when the extension activates.

flm-vscode.debugStreaming.description: Include raw streaming responses and model reasoning in the activity log and dedicated chat panel.

flm-vscode.allowWorkspaceWrites.description: Allow @flm to request writes to files in the first workspace folder. Every write still requires confirmation.

flm-vscode.memoryFile.description: Workspace-relative persistent memory file shared with harnesses and agents.

flm-vscode.externalAgents.description: External harnesses that @flm may invoke by name, such as Hermes. Prompts are sent on stdin unless an argument contains {prompt}; version and installer settings enable update checks.

versionArgs.description: Arguments used to read the installed version.

latestVersionField.description: Dot-separated JSON field containing the latest version.

installCommand.description: Installer executable, such as npm or pip.

installArgs.description: Installer arguments; {version} is replaced with the latest version.

flm-vscode.selectedAgent.description: Default harness or agent for @flm requests. Use none for FastFlowLM or choose a configured external agent name.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
